highlights: Log In and Sign Up toggle
notes: A Log In / Sign Up toggle sits above buttons for Google, Microsoft, Apple and 'Log In with your Organization', followed by an email and password form with a yellow Log In button and a pre-ticked 'Keep me signed in'. The right half is a blue promo panel with a mock Apollo Chrome extension card and a 'Get Apollo Chrome Extension' button. Nothing on the page names the requesting app or lists permissions.
